title: Death toll surpasses 1,000 in Lebanon as Israeli bombardment continues
partialText: At least 40 medical workers among those killed as rights groups urge Israel to end attacks on Lebanon health facilities.

title: Hegseth insists US is meeting Iran war objectives

title: Hegseth says no ‘timeframe’ for war on Iran as Pentagon asks for $200bn

title: “It’s time to end the war.” UN’s Guterres urges US, Israel to cease attacks
partialText: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned the US and Israel of “potential tragic consequences” from the war in Iran.

title: Child among survivors pulled from rubble of US-Israeli attack in Iran
partialText: Video from Iran’s Red Crescent showed a child among survivors pulled from the wreckage of a US-Israeli air attack.

title: Drone attack from Sudan kills 17 people in Chad as war spills over border
partialText: Local resident says casualties include mourners at funeral and children playing nearby.

title: China’s silence on Iran reveals its true priorities
partialText: Beijing's muted response shows that when core interests are at stake, even close partners are expendable.

title: Morocco says stripping Senegal of AFCON win ‘upholds rights and integrity’

title: Why are Iran’s South Pars gasfield, Qatar’s Ras Laffan, so significant?

title: The US–Israel war with Iran will not end with a clear victor
partialText: An arrangement that allows each side to claim it achieved its core goals is the most likely path out.

title: Iran’s dilemma in war and peace

title: Nigeria’s Osimhen tried to defy broken arm in Galatasaray loss at Liverpool

title: Gabbard says Pakistan missiles a future threat to US, but experts push back

title: Iran war: What’s the Jones Act, and why has Trump suspended it for 60 days?
